items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Pretty good how you are, Bart?

ctx.x: But the rag got stuck in the floor.

Yeah, yeah. And that pulled, but that pulled from the metal joint. It broke right there. Yeah. And so he was the fella by the name of Benny. He was to send it back. I don't know all them old boys, but me and Joe Dart, we used to work together. Pretty good how you are, Bart? Thank you, thank you. Me and Joe Dart used to work together. The clarinetist. The clarinetist. Was his name, was it Johnny Dodds or what? Yeah, Joe, he used to call him Joe. Joe. Well, he used to go on the job with his clarinet. He and them…
He's the one you say his brother was the drummer. Drummer, yeah.
